name: Kevin Needham
role: The day driver on Mickey's rank, car one; the Widow's eyes among the regulars
temper_why: moaning, talkative; skims 42 miles a week; the Widow's eyes; wants to be asked (CAST)

card.who: Mickey's day driver, eight years in the same seat.
card.speak: Easy, matey, a moaner about the weather and the fares.
card.life: Lives out past the station. Worries the office will shut.
card.fire: He was in bed. Terry had the night car.
card.rivals: He has driven Agar's clerk and never had a tip.
card.secret: Tells the Widow's people what goes out over Mickey's radio; she is his landlord at the gate (2.10.2).

fallback_role: a car short until a driver is hired
